We have deliberated and ask to carry out the imperial will by assigning Attending Censor Zhang Chi, Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household Ju Keyou, Palace Attending Censor Shuai Ting, Director Deng Shouzhong of the Bureau of Appointments, Director Wang Ying of the Bureau of Granaries, Vice Director Jia Bi of the Bureau of Seals, Erudite Zhao Li of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Erudite Li Guangzan of the Directorate of Education, Senior Rectifier Su Xiao, Junior Mentor Wang Shen—ten men in all—to compile new regulations and bind them into fascicles.

Focus unit names exactly ten officials ending in 王伸等一十人; 等 closes the named list and 一十人 confirms the total is those ten. Adding 'and nine others' invents extra persons after all ten are already listed; the proposed cut restores the count.

Your subjects have deliberated and ask to carry out the sage edict, and further request that Attending Censor in charge of miscellaneous matters Zhang Chi, Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household Ju Keyou, Palace Attending Censor Shuai Ting, Director of the Bureau of Appointments Deng Shouzhong, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Wang Ying, Vice Director of the Bureau of Seals Jia Bi, Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhao Li, Erudite of the Directorate of Education Li Guangzan, Senior Rectifier Su Xiao, and Junior Mentor Wang Shen and nine others—ten men in all—be assigned to compile new regulations and bind them into fascicles.

The same Chinese list ends 王伸等一十人: ten named men, not ten including nine unnamed others. Removing 'and nine others' from the literal matches 一十人 without inventing surplus assignees.
We have examined the text and find the work throughout refined and thorough.
Your subjects Zhi and Pu have examined the text and find the work throughout refined and thorough.
Chinese opens with 臣質、臣溥 as the memorialists who 據文評議; the idiomatic 'We' drops those named subjects. Restoring Zhi and Pu recovers the attribution already present in the literal.
some are driven into false guilt;
Under 捶楚, 或陷無辜 means some innocent people are trapped or framed into guilt, not that anyone 'falls into guiltlessness.' The proposed wording matches that sense and the idiomatic field.

The censor is 蕭頃; 頃 is Qing (qǐng), not Qi. Replacing Xiao Qi with Xiao Qing corrects the given-name romanization while leaving titles and the rest of the sentence unchanged.

units.zh: 梁太祖開平三年十一月，詔太常卿李燕、御史蕭頃、中書舍人張兗、戶部侍郎崔沂、大理卿王鄯、刑部郎中崔誥，共刪定律令格式。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the third year of Kaiping, Emperor Taizu of Liang ordered Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan, Censor Xiao Qing, Secretariat Drafter Zhang Chong, Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yi, Minister of Justice Wang Shan, and Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cui Gao to revise the statutes, ordinances, formats, and regulations together.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Kaiping of Emperor Taizu of Liang, an edict ordered Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan, Censor Xiao Qing, Secretariat Drafter Zhang Chong, Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yi, Minister of Justice Wang Shan, and Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cui Gao jointly to revise the statutes, ordinances, formats, and regulations.

units.zh: 四年十二月，宰臣薛貽矩奏：「太常卿李燕等重刊定律令三十卷，式二十卷，格一十卷，並目錄一十三卷，律疏三十卷，凡五部一十帙，共一百三卷。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, Chief Minister Xue Yiju reported: "Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan and his colleagues have newly printed and fixed the statutes in thirty scrolls, formats in twenty, regulations in ten, a table of contents in thirteen, and the statutory commentary in thirty—five parts in ten fascicles, one hundred and three scrolls in all.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, Chief Minister Xue Yiju memorialized: "Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan and others have newly printed and fixed the statutes in thirty scrolls, the formats in twenty scrolls, the regulations in ten scrolls, together with a table of contents in thirteen scrolls and the commentary on the statutes in thirty scrolls, altogether five parts in ten fascicles, comprising one hundred and three scrolls in all.

units.zh: 敕中書舍人李仁儉詣閣門奉進，伏請目為《大梁新定格式律令》，仍頒下施行。」
units.en: We ask that Secretariat Drafter Li Renjian be sent to present them at the Palace Gate, and that they be titled The Newly Fixed Statutes, Ordinances, Formats, and Regulations of Great Liang and promulgated for enforcement."
units.literal: We request that Secretariat Drafter Li Renjian be ordered to present them at the Palace Gate; we bow and ask that they be titled The Newly Fixed Statutes, Ordinances, Formats, and Regulations of Great Liang, and that they be issued for enforcement."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 〈（原註：是時，大理卿李保殷進所撰《刑律總要》十二卷。）〉
units.en: (Original note: At this time Minister of Justice Li Baoyin presented the twelve-scroll General Essentials of Penal Law that he had compiled.)〉
units.literal: (Original note: At this time Minister of Justice Li Baoyin presented the General Essentials of Penal Law in twelve scrolls that he had compiled.)〉

units.zh: 唐莊宗同光元年十二月，御史臺奏：「當司刑部、大理寺本朝法書，自朱溫僭逆，刪改事條，或重貨財，輕入人命，或自徇枉過，濫加刑罰。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the first year of Tongguang, Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang received a memorial from the Censorate: "The law books of our bureau, the Ministry of Justice, and the Court of Judicial Review—ever since Zhu Wen's usurpation—have had their articles revised, sometimes treating property crimes more harshly than loss of life, sometimes indulging personal bias and imposing punishments arbitrarily.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Tongguang of Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang, the Censorate memorialized: "The penal codes of our bureau, the Ministry of Justice, and the Court of Judicial Review in this dynasty's law books—since Zhu Wen's usurpation, article after article was revised, sometimes making property offences heavy and human life light, sometimes indulging personal wrongs and adding punishments at will.

units.zh: 今見在三司收貯刑書，並是偽廷刪改者，兼偽廷先下諸道追取本朝法書焚毀，或經兵火所遺，皆無舊本節目。
units.en: The penal codes now in the archives of the three offices are all versions the usurping court had revised; that court had also ordered the circuits to seize and burn our dynasty's law books, and what survived the wars no longer preserves the original section headings.
units.literal: The penal books now held in storage by the three offices are all versions revised by the usurping court; moreover the usurping court earlier ordered the circuits to seize and burn this dynasty's law books, and those that survived war and fire lack the old section headings.

units.zh: 只定州敕庫有本朝法書具在，請敕定州節度使速寫副本進納，庶刑法令式，並合本朝舊制。」
units.en: Only the edict archive at Dingzhou still holds our dynasty's law books intact. We ask that the military governor of Dingzhou be ordered to copy and submit duplicates at once, so that penal statutes, ordinances, and formats may again follow our dynasty's former system."
units.literal: Only the edict archive of Dingzhou still has this dynasty's law books intact; we request an edict ordering the military governor of Dingzhou speedily to copy and submit duplicates, so that the statutes, ordinances, and formats of penal law may all accord with this dynasty's former system."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 未幾，定州王都進納唐朝格式律令，凡二百八十六卷。
units.en: Soon afterward Wang Du of Dingzhou submitted the Tang regulations, formats, statutes, and ordinances—two hundred and eighty-six scrolls in all.
units.literal: Before long, Wang Du of Dingzhou submitted the Tang dynasty's regulations, formats, statutes, and ordinances, altogether two hundred and eighty-six scrolls.

units.zh: 二年二月，刑部尚書盧價奏，纂集《同光刑律統類》凡一十三卷，上之。
units.en: In the second month of the second year, Minister of Justice Lu Jia reported that he had compiled the thirteen-scroll Tongguang Comprehensive Categories of Penal Statutes and submitted them to the throne.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year, Minister of Justice Lu Jia memorialized that he had compiled the Tongguang Comprehensive Categories of Penal Statutes in thirteen scrolls and presented them.

units.zh: 周太祖廣順元年六月，敕侍御史盧億、刑部員外郎曹匪躬、大理正段濤同議定重寫法書一百四十八卷。
units.en: In the sixth month of the first year of Guangshun, Emperor Taizu of Zhou ordered Attending Censor Lu Yi, Vice Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cao Feigong, and Senior Rectifier Duan Tao of the Court of Judicial Review to deliberate together and rewrite the law books in one hundred and forty-eight scrolls.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Guangshun of Emperor Taizu of Zhou, an edict ordered Attending Censor Lu Yi, Vice Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cao Feigong, and Senior Rectifier of the Court of Judicial Review Duan Tao jointly to deliberate and rewrite the law books in one hundred and forty-eight scrolls.

units.zh: 先是，漢隱帝末，因兵亂法書亡失，至是大理奏重寫律令格式、統類編敕，凡改點畫及義理之誤字凡二百一十有四，以晉、漢及國初事關刑法敕條，凡二十六件，分為二卷，附於編敕，目為《大周續編敕》，命省、寺行用焉。
units.en: Earlier, at the end of the Han reign of Emperor Yin, the law books had been lost in the wars. The Court of Judicial Review now memorialized for a rewrite of the statutes, ordinances, formats, comprehensive categories, and compiled edicts, correcting two hundred and fourteen mistaken characters in form or meaning, and gathering twenty-six edict articles on penal law from the Jin and Han periods and the founding of the state into two scrolls appended to the compiled edicts under the title Great Zhou Supplementary Compiled Edicts, with orders for the ministries and courts to put them into use.
units.literal: Earlier, at the end of Emperor Yin of Han, the law books were lost in the turmoil of war; thereupon the Court of Judicial Review memorialized for the rewriting of statutes, ordinances, formats, comprehensive categories, and compiled edicts, correcting in all two hundred and fourteen erroneous characters in strokes and meaning, and taking twenty-six edict articles concerning penal law from Jin, Han, and the opening of the state, divided into two scrolls, appended to the compiled edicts, titled the Great Zhou Supplementary Compiled Edicts, and ordered the ministries and courts to employ them.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史》：盧億，周初為侍御史，漢末兵亂，法書亡失，至是大理奏重寫律令格式、統類編敕，乃詔億與刑部員外曹匪躬、大理正段濤同加議定舊本，以京兆府改同五府，開封、大名府改同河南府，長安、萬年改為次赤縣，開封、浚儀、大名、元城改為赤縣，又定東京諸門薰風等為京城門，明德等為皇城門，啟運等為宮城門，升龍等為宮門，崇元等為殿門，廟諱書不成字，凡改點畫及義理之誤字二百一十有四。
units.en: (History of Song: Lu Yi served as Attending Censor in early Zhou. At the end of Han the law books were lost in the wars, and when the Court of Judicial Review memorialized for a rewrite of the statutes, ordinances, formats, comprehensive categories, and compiled edicts, the court ordered Yi, Vice Director Cao Feigong of the Bureau of Punishments, and Senior Rectifier Duan Tao to revise the old text together. Jingzhao Prefecture was raised to rank with the Five Prefectures; Kaifeng and Daming were made equivalent to Henan Prefecture; Chang'an and Wannian became secondary red counties and Kaifeng, Junyi, Daming, and Yuancheng became red counties. The gates of the Eastern Capital were classified—Xunfeng and the like as capital-city gates, Mingde as imperial-city gates, Qiyun as palace-city gates, Shenglong as palace gates, and Chongyuan as hall gates. Taboo forms for temple names were written incompletely. In all, two hundred and fourteen mistaken characters in form or meaning were corrected.
units.literal: (History of Song: Lu Yi, in early Zhou served as Attending Censor; at the end of Han the law books were lost in military disorder; thereupon the Court of Judicial Review memorialized for rewriting statutes, ordinances, formats, comprehensive categories, and compiled edicts, and an edict ordered Yi together with Vice Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cao Feigong and Senior Rectifier Duan Tao jointly to deliberate on the old text, changing Jingzhao Prefecture to rank with the Five Prefectures, Kaifeng and Daming prefectures to rank with Henan Prefecture, Chang'an and Wannian to secondary red counties, Kaifeng, Junyi, Daming, and Yuancheng to red counties, and further fixing the gates of the Eastern Capital such as Xunfeng as capital-city gates, Mingde as imperial-city gates, Qiyun as palace-city gates, Shenglong as palace gates, and Chongyuan as hall gates; taboo characters for temple names were written incompletely; altogether two hundred and fourteen erroneous characters in strokes and meaning were corrected.

units.zh: 又以晉、漢及周初事關刑法敕條者，分為二卷，附編敕，目為《大周續編敕》。
units.en: Edict articles on penal law from the Jin and Han periods and early Zhou were also divided into two scrolls, appended to the compiled edicts under the title Great Zhou Supplementary Compiled Edicts.
units.literal: Further, edict articles concerning penal law from Jin, Han, and early Zhou were divided into two scrolls, appended to the compiled edicts, and titled the Great Zhou Supplementary Compiled Edicts.

units.zh: 詔行之。）〉
units.en: An edict ordered them promulgated.)〉
units.literal: An edict ordered them put into effect.)〉

units.zh: 二年二月，中書門下奏：「準元年正月五日赦書節文，今後應犯竊盜贓及和奸者，並依晉天福元年已前條制施行。
units.en: In the second month of the second year, the Secretariat reported: "Under the amnesty edict of the fifth day of the first month of the founding year, theft and consensual adultery are hereafter to be punished under the rules that applied before the first year of Tianfu of Jin.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year, the Secretariat memorialized: "According to the section of the amnesty edict of the fifth day of the first month of the first year, henceforth those who commit theft of goods or consensual adultery shall all be handled according to the provisions in force before the first year of Tianfu of Jin.

units.zh: 諸處犯罪人等，除反逆罪外，其餘罪並不籍沒家產、誅及骨肉，一依格令處分者。
units.en: Except for rebellion and treason, offenders everywhere are not to have their property confiscated or their kin executed, but are to be punished solely under the regulations and ordinances.
units.literal: Criminals everywhere, except for crimes of rebellion and treason, for all other crimes shall not have their household property confiscated or their kin executed, but shall be dealt with entirely according to regulations and ordinances.

units.zh: 請再下明敕，頒示天下。」
units.en: We ask that a clear edict be issued again and promulgated throughout the realm."
units.literal: We request that a clear edict again be issued and promulgated throughout the realm."

units.zh: 乃下詔曰：「赦書節文，明有厘革，切慮邊城遠郡，未得審詳，宜更申明，免至差誤。
units.en: The throne then issued an edict: "The amnesty clearly revised the law, but we fear that distant border prefectures may not have grasped it fully. It should be clarified again so that no mistake is made.
units.literal: Thereupon an imperial edict stated: "The section of the amnesty edict clearly revised the law; we are deeply concerned that remote border prefectures may not have examined it in detail, and it should be clarified again to avoid error.

units.zh: 其盜賊，若是強盜，並準自來格條斷遣；
units.en: Robbers who commit armed robbery are to be sentenced under the standing regulatory articles;
units.literal: As for robbers, if they are armed robbers, they shall all be sentenced according to the standing regulatory articles;

units.zh: 其犯竊盜者，計贓絹滿三匹已上者，並集眾決殺，其絹以本處上估價為定，不滿三匹者，等第決斷。
units.en: petty thieves whose booty in silk amounts to three bolts or more are all to be executed before the assembled crowd, with valuation at the highest local estimate; when the amount falls short of three bolts, sentence is to be passed by graduated ranks.
units.literal: those who commit theft shall, when the stolen goods in silk amount to three bolts or more, all be executed before the assembled crowd; the silk shall be valued at the highest estimate of the locality, and when it does not reach three bolts, sentence shall be passed by graduated ranks.

units.zh: 應有夫婦人被強奸者，男子決殺，婦人不坐；
units.en: In cases of forcible violation of a married woman, the man is to be executed and the woman is not punished;
units.literal: where a married woman has been forcibly violated, the man shall be executed and the woman shall not be punished;

units.zh: 其犯和奸者，並準律科斷，罪不至死。
units.en: consensual adultery is to be sentenced under the statutes, with no capital penalty.
units.literal: those who commit consensual adultery shall all be sentenced according to the statutes, and the offence does not reach death.

units.zh: 其餘奸私罪犯，準格律處分。
units.en: All other sexual offences are to be handled under the statutes and regulations.
units.literal: All other offences of illicit relations shall be dealt with according to statutes and regulations.

units.zh: 應諸色罪人，除謀反大逆外，其餘並不得誅殺骨肉、籍沒家產。」
units.en: Except for plotting rebellion and great treason, no offender of any kind may have kin executed or household property confiscated."
units.literal: All criminals of every kind, except for plotting rebellion and great treason, for the rest may not have their kin executed or their household property confiscated."

units.zh: 先是，晉天福中敕，凡和奸者，男子婦人並處極法，至是始改從律文焉。
units.en: Earlier, a Jin edict of the Tianfu period had imposed the death penalty on both parties in every case of consensual adultery; only now was the law brought back into line with the statutes.
units.literal: Earlier, in an edict of the Tianfu period of Jin, all who committed consensual adultery, men and women alike, were punished by the extreme penalty; only at this time was the change made to follow the statutory text.

units.zh: 世宗顯德四年五月，中書門下奏：「準宣，法書行用多時，文意古質，條目繁細，使人難會，兼前後敕格，互換重疊，亦難詳定。
units.en: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Xiande, Emperor Shizong received a memorial from the Secretariat: "As the throne has directed, the law books have been in force for many years. Their language is archaic and their articles minute and numerous, so that readers struggle to grasp them; edicts and regulations from different periods also overlap and repeat, making reliable application difficult.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Xiande of Emperor Shizong, the Secretariat memorialized: "According to the imperial pronouncement, the law books have been in use for a long time; their language is archaic and their articles numerous and minute, making them hard to understand; moreover edicts and regulations before and after overlap and duplicate one another, and are also hard to fix with certainty.

units.zh: 宜令中書門下並重刪定，務從節要，所貴天下易為詳究者。
units.en: The Secretariat should be ordered to revise them again, aiming for brevity and essentials so that the whole realm can study and apply them with ease.
units.literal: It is fitting to order the Secretariat again to revise them, striving for brevity and essentials, so that throughout the realm they may easily be studied in detail.

units.zh: 伏以刑法者御人之銜勒，救弊之斧斤，故鞭撲不可一日弛之於家，刑法不可一日廢之於國，雖堯、舜淳古之代，亦不能舍此而致理矣。
units.en: Penal law is the bridle by which people are governed and the tool by which abuses are cut away. Flogging cannot be relaxed for a day in the household, nor penal law abandoned for a day in the state—even the pure antiquity of Yao and Shun could not achieve good order without it.
units.literal: We submit that penal law is the bridle by which people are governed and the axe by which abuses are remedied; therefore flogging cannot for a single day be relaxed in the household, nor penal law for a single day be abandoned in the state—even in the pure antiquity of Yao and Shun one could not discard this and achieve good order.

units.zh: 今奉制旨刪定律令，有以見聖君欽恤明罰敕法之意也。
units.en: In obeying the imperial order to revise the statutes and ordinances, we see the sage ruler's intent to temper punishment with compassion and to make the law clear.
units.literal: Now in receiving the imperial order to revise statutes and ordinances, one may see the sage ruler's intent of reverent compassion, clear punishment, and instructing the law.

units.zh: 竊以律令之書，政理之本，經聖賢之損益，為古今之章程，歷代以來，謂之彜典。
units.en: Books of statutes and ordinances are the foundation of government. Revised by sages through the ages, they form the enduring institutions of past and present and have long been regarded as the constant canon.
units.literal: We venture to consider that books of statutes and ordinances are the root of government and order, having passed through the additions and subtractions of sages, serving as institutions for past and present; through successive ages they have been called the constant canon.

units.zh: 今朝廷之所行用者律一十二卷、律疏三十卷、式二十卷、令三十卷、《開成格》一十卷、《大中統類》一十二卷、後唐以來至漢末編敕三十二卷及皇朝制敕等。
units.en: The court now applies twelve scrolls of statutes, thirty of statutory commentary, twenty of formats, thirty of ordinances, ten of the Kaicheng Regulations, twelve of the Dazhong Comprehensive Categories, thirty-two scrolls of compiled edicts from Later Tang through the end of Han, and the regulatory edicts of the present dynasty.
units.literal: What the court now employs are twelve scrolls of statutes, thirty scrolls of statutory commentary, twenty scrolls of formats, thirty scrolls of ordinances, ten scrolls of the Kaicheng Regulations, twelve scrolls of the Dazhong Comprehensive Categories, thirty-two scrolls of compiled edicts from Later Tang down to the end of Han, and the present dynasty's regulatory edicts, and so forth.

units.zh: 折獄定刑，無出於此。
units.en: Nothing lies outside these books when cases are decided and punishments fixed.
units.literal: In deciding cases and fixing punishments, nothing lies outside these.

units.zh: 律令則文辭古質，看覽者難以詳明；
units.en: The statutes and ordinances are couched in archaic language that readers struggle to master;
units.literal: Statutes and ordinances have archaic language, and those who read them find it hard to understand them fully;

units.zh: 格敕則條目繁多，檢閱者或有疑誤。
units.en: the regulations and edicts are so numerous that those who consult them may easily go astray.
units.literal: regulations and edicts have numerous articles, and those who consult them may harbor doubt or error.

units.zh: 加之邊遠之地，貪猾之徒，緣此為奸，浸以成弊。
units.en: In remote regions, moreover, the greedy and cunning exploit the confusion to commit abuses that gradually become entrenched.
units.literal: Added to this, in remote regions greedy and cunning persons take advantage of this to commit wrongdoing, and the abuse gradually becomes entrenched.

units.zh: 方屬盛明之運，宜伸畫一之規，所冀民不陷刑，吏知所守。
units.en: In this flourishing age it is fitting to enforce a single uniform rule, so that the people do not fall into punishment through ignorance and officials know what to uphold.
units.literal: Now that we belong to an era of flourishing brilliance, it is fitting to extend a uniform rule, in the hope that the people will not fall into punishment and officials will know what to uphold.

units.zh: 臣等商量，望準聖旨施行，仍差侍御史知雜事張湜、太子右庶子劇可久、殿中侍御史率汀、職方郎中鄧守中、倉部郎中王瑩、司封員外郎賈比、太常博士趙礪、國子博士李光贊、大理正蘇曉、太子中允王伸等一十人，編集新格，勒成部帙。
units.en: We have deliberated and ask to carry out the imperial will by assigning Attending Censor Zhang Chi, Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household Ju Keyou, Palace Attending Censor Shuai Ting, Director Deng Shouzhong of the Bureau of Appointments, Director Wang Ying of the Bureau of Granaries, Vice Director Jia Bi of the Bureau of Seals, Erudite Zhao Li of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Erudite Li Guangzan of the Directorate of Education, Senior Rectifier Su Xiao, Junior Mentor Wang Shen—ten men in all—to compile new regulations and bind them into fascicles.
units.literal: Your subjects have deliberated and ask to carry out the sage edict, and further request that Attending Censor in charge of miscellaneous matters Zhang Chi, Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household Ju Keyou, Palace Attending Censor Shuai Ting, Director of the Bureau of Appointments Deng Shouzhong, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Wang Ying, Vice Director of the Bureau of Seals Jia Bi, Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhao Li, Erudite of the Directorate of Education Li Guangzan, Senior Rectifier Su Xiao, and Junior Mentor Wang Shen—ten men in all—be assigned to compile new regulations and bind them into fascicles.

units.zh: 律令之有難解者，就文訓釋；
units.en: Where statutes and ordinances are obscure, they should be glossed in the text itself;
units.literal: Where statutes and ordinances are hard to understand, gloss them according to the text;

units.zh: 格敕之有繁雜者，隨事刪除。
units.en: where regulations and edicts are redundant, articles should be cut as the subject requires.
units.literal: where regulations and edicts are redundant, delete them according to the matter.

units.zh: 止要諧理省文，兼且直書易會。
units.en: The aim is coherent reasoning and concise language, written plainly so that readers can grasp it at once.
units.literal: We need only harmonize reason and economize language, and moreover write plainly so that they are easy to grasp.

units.zh: 其中有輕重未當，便於古而不便於今，矛盾相違，可於此而不可於彼，盡宜改正，無或牽拘。
units.en: Where penalties are ill matched, what suited antiquity no longer suits the present, or provisions contradict one another, everything should be corrected without undue constraint.
units.literal: Among them, where severity and leniency are inappropriate, what suited antiquity does not suit the present, or provisions contradict and conflict, what applies here does not apply there—all should be corrected without being bound by constraint.

units.zh: 候編集畢日，委御史臺、尚書省四品以上及兩省五品以上官參詳可否，送中書門下議定，奏取進止。」
units.en: When the compilation is finished, officials of the fourth rank and above in the Censorate and Department of State Affairs and of the fifth rank and above in the Two Departments should review it, the Secretariat should deliberate and fix the text, and a memorial should be submitted for the throne's decision."
units.literal: When compilation is finished, commission officials of the fourth rank and above in the Censorate and Department of State Affairs and of the fifth rank and above in the Two Departments to examine whether it is feasible, send it to the Secretariat for deliberation and fixation, and memorialize for imperial decision."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the proposal.
units.literal: An edict approved.

units.zh: 自是湜等於都省集議刪定，仍令大官供膳。
units.en: Thereafter Chi and his colleagues met at the capital offices to revise the code, and the Court of Imperial Entertainments was ordered to supply their meals.
units.literal: Thereafter Chi and the others met at the capital offices to deliberate and revise, and the Court of Imperial Entertainments was ordered to provide meals.

units.zh: 五年七月，中書門下奏：「侍御史知雜事張湜等九人，奉詔編集刑書，悉有條貫，兵部尚書張昭等一十人，參詳旨要，更加損益。
units.en: In the seventh month of the fifth year, the Secretariat reported: "Attending Censor Zhang Chi and eight others, acting on the imperial edict to compile the penal code, have brought every article into systematic order; Minister of War Zhang Zhao and nine others have reviewed the essentials and made further revisions.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, the Secretariat memorialized: "Attending Censor in charge of miscellaneous matters Zhang Chi and eight others, receiving the edict to compile the penal books, have arranged them all in systematic order; Minister of War Zhang Zhao and nine others have examined the essential points and further added revisions.

units.zh: 臣質、臣溥據文評議，備見精審。
units.en: Your subjects Zhi and Pu have examined the text and find the work throughout refined and thorough.
units.literal: Your subjects Zhi and Pu have judged by the text and find it throughout refined and thorough.

units.zh: 其所編集者，用律為正；
units.en: The compilation takes the statutes as its standard;
units.literal: What they have compiled takes the statutes as the standard;

units.zh: 辭旨之有難解者，釋以疏意；
units.en: where the wording is obscure, it is explained by the commentary;
units.literal: where the wording is hard to understand, it is explained by the sense of the commentary;

units.zh: 義理之有易了者，略其疏文。
units.en: where the meaning is plain, the commentary is abbreviated.
units.literal: where the meaning is easy to grasp, the commentary text is abbreviated.

units.zh: 式令之有附近者次之，格敕之有廢置者又次之。
units.en: Relevant formats and ordinances follow next, then regulations and edicts that have been abolished or set aside.
units.literal: Formats and ordinances that are relevant come next; regulations and edicts that have been abolished or set aside come after that.

units.zh: 事有不便於今、該說未盡者，別立新條於本條之下；
units.en: Where present conditions make an article inconvenient or the explanation is incomplete, new articles are added beneath the original;
units.literal: Matters inconvenient for the present or not fully covered in explanation have new articles set up beneath the original article;

units.zh: 其有文理深古、慮人疑惑者，別以朱字訓釋。
units.en: where the language is profoundly archaic and likely to perplex readers, glosses in red characters are supplied.
units.literal: where the language is profoundly archaic and readers might be perplexed, separate glosses in red characters are provided.

units.zh: 至於朝廷之禁令，州縣之常科，各以類分，悉令編附。
units.en: Court prohibitions and the standing statutes of prefectures and counties are each classified by type and all appended to the compilation.
units.literal: As for court prohibitions and the standing statutes of prefectures and counties, each is classified by category and all are ordered compiled and appended.

units.zh: 所冀發函展卷，綱目無遺，究本討源，刑政咸在。
units.en: The hope is that on opening the case and unrolling the scrolls, no heading is missing and the whole of penal administration, traced to its roots, lies within.
units.literal: The hope is that on opening the case and unrolling the scrolls, no heading or item is missing, and tracing root and source, all penal administration is contained therein.

units.zh: 其所編集，勒成一部，別有目錄，凡二十一卷。
units.en: The compilation is bound as one work with a separate table of contents, twenty-one scrolls in all.
units.literal: What they have compiled is bound into one work, with a separate table of contents, twenty-one scrolls in all.

units.zh: 刑名之要，盡統於茲，目之為《大周刑統》，欲請頒行天下，與律疏令式通行。
units.en: The essentials of penal nomenclature are all gathered here under the title Great Zhou Penal Compendium. We ask that it be promulgated throughout the realm and applied together with the statutes, commentary, ordinances, and formats.
units.literal: The essentials of penal nomenclature are all gathered here; it is titled the Great Zhou Penal Compendium; we wish to request that it be promulgated throughout the realm and applied together with the statutes, commentary, ordinances, and formats.

units.zh: 其《刑法統類》、《開成格》、編敕等，采掇既盡，不在法司行使之限，自來有宣命指揮公事及三司臨時條法，州縣見今施行，不在編集之數。
units.en: The Comprehensive Categories of Penal Law, the Kaicheng Regulations, compiled edicts, and the like have been fully drawn upon and lie outside what the judicial offices enforce on their own. Imperial orders on official business and provisional regulations of the three offices that prefectures and counties now apply are not included in the compilation.
units.literal: The Comprehensive Categories of Penal Law, the Kaicheng Regulations, compiled edicts, and the like, having been fully drawn upon, lie outside the scope of what the judicial offices may enforce; as for imperial orders directing official business and provisional regulations of the three offices that prefectures and counties are now applying, they are not included in the compilation.

units.zh: 應該京百司公事，逐司各有見行條件，望令本司刪集，送中書門下詳議聞奏。」
units.en: Each capital office has regulations now in force for its own affairs; we ask that each office revise and compile them and submit them to the Secretariat for deliberation and report to the throne."
units.literal: As for the official business of the hundred offices of the capital, each office has its own regulations now in force; we hope each office may be ordered to revise and compile them and send them to the Secretariat for detailed deliberation and report."

units.zh: 敕宜依，仍頒行天下。
units.en: The edict approved the proposal, and the work was promulgated throughout the realm.
units.literal: An edict approved, and it was further promulgated throughout the realm.

units.zh: 乃賜侍御史知雜事張湜等九人各銀器二十兩，雜彩三十匹，賞刪定《刑統》之勞也。
units.en: Zhang Chi and the eight other compilers were each rewarded with twenty taels of silver vessels and thirty bolts of mixed silks for their labor in revising the Penal Compendium.
units.literal: Thereupon Attending Censor in charge of miscellaneous matters Zhang Chi and eight others were each granted twenty taels of silver vessels and thirty bolts of mixed silks, rewarding their labor in revising the Penal Compendium.

units.zh: 唐同光二年六月己巳，敕：「應御史臺河南府行臺馬步司左右軍巡院，見禁囚徒，據罪輕重，限十日內並須決遣申奏。
units.en: On the day jisi of the sixth month of the second year of Tongguang, an edict ordered: "All prisoners held in the Censorate, the Henan branch secretariat, the cavalry and infantry offices, and the left and right military patrol courts must be sentenced and reported within ten days according to the severity of the offence.
units.literal: On the day jisi of the sixth month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, an edict stated: "All prisoners now detained in the Censorate, the Henan Prefecture branch secretariat, the cavalry and infantry offices, and the left and right military patrol courts must, according to the severity of the offence, be sentenced and reported within ten days.

units.zh: 仍委四京、諸道州府，見禁囚徒，速宜疏決，不得淹停，兼恐內外形勢官員私事寄禁，切要止絕，俾無冤滯。」
units.en: The four capitals and the prefectures of every circuit are likewise charged to try and release detained prisoners at once without delay. Officials inside and outside the capital who hold prisoners on private grounds must be stopped, so that no one languishes unjustly in custody."
units.literal: It is further commissioned to the four capitals and the prefectures and districts of all circuits that prisoners now detained should speedily be tried and released and must not be delayed; moreover, fearing that inner and outer officials of influence detain people on private matters, this must strictly be stopped, so that there are no wrongful delays."

units.zh: 三年五月己未，敕：「在京、及諸道州府，所禁罪人，如無大過，速令疏決，不得淹滯。」
units.en: On the day jiwei of the fifth month of the third year, an edict ordered: "In the capital and in every circuit, detained offenders without grave offences are to be tried and released at once and must not be held in prolonged detention."
units.literal: On the day jiwei of the fifth month of the third year, an edict stated: "In the capital and in the prefectures of all circuits, prisoners who are detained, if they have no grave offence, shall speedily be tried and released and must not be delayed."

units.zh: 六月甲寅，敕：「刑以秋冬，雖關惻隱，罪多連累，翻慮滯淹。
units.en: On the day jiayin of the sixth month, an edict stated: "The rule that punishments are carried out in autumn and winter reflects humane concern, yet when crimes involve many persons in succession, prolonged detention becomes the greater worry.
units.literal: On the day jiayin of the sixth month, an edict stated: "Punishment in autumn and winter, though it concerns compassion, when crimes involve many persons in succession, one instead fears prolonged detention.

units.zh: 若或十人之中，止為一夫抵死，豈可以輕附重，禁錮逾時。
units.en: If among ten defendants only one man must die, how can the lesser be held with the greater and kept in confinement beyond its proper term?
units.literal: If among ten persons only one man must die in requital, how can the light be attached to the heavy and imprisonment exceed its time?

units.zh: 言念哀矜，又難全廢。
units.en: Compassion demands restraint, yet the seasonal rule cannot be abandoned altogether.
units.literal: Speaking of compassionate concern, it is again hard to abolish it entirely.

units.zh: 其諸司囚徒，罪無輕重，並宜各委本司，據罪詳斷申奏，輕者即時疏理，重者候過立春，至秋分然後行法。
units.en: Prisoners in every office, whether the offence is light or heavy, should be entrusted to their own offices to judge according to the crime and report upward. Light offences are to be tried and released at once; heavy ones are to wait until after the Beginning of Spring and be executed only between then and the Autumn Equinox.
units.literal: Prisoners of the various offices, whether the crime is light or heavy, should all be entrusted to their own offices to judge in detail according to the crime and memorialize; the light shall be tried and released at once, the heavy shall wait until after the Beginning of Spring and then be punished from then until the Autumn Equinox.

units.zh: 如是事系軍機，須行嚴令，或謀惡逆，或畜奸邪，或行劫殺人，難於留滯，並不在此限。」
units.en: Matters of military urgency requiring strict enforcement, plotting wicked rebellion, harboring treachery, or robbery and murder—cases that cannot be delayed—are all outside this limit."
units.literal: If the matter concerns military urgency and strict orders must be applied, or plotting wicked rebellion, or harboring treachery and evil, or committing robbery and killing, which are hard to detain, all are outside this limit."

units.zh: 天成元年十一月庚申，敕：「應天下州使系囚，除大辟罪以上，委所在長吏，速推勘決斷，不得傍追證對，經過食宿之地，除當死刑外，並仰釋放，兼不許懲治。」
units.en: On the day gengshen of the eleventh month of the first year of Tiancheng, an edict ordered: "Throughout the realm, detained prisoners—except for capital offences and above—are to be investigated and sentenced at once by local chief officials without pursuing collateral witnesses. At every place of lodging along the route, all except those liable to death are to be released, and no punishment is permitted."
units.literal: On the day gengshen of the eleventh month of the first year of Tiancheng, an edict stated: "All prisoners detained in prefectures throughout the realm, except for capital crimes and above, are entrusted to the local chief officials to investigate and decide speedily; they must not pursue collateral witnesses, and in places passed through for lodging and food, except those liable to death, all are ordered released, and punishment is also not permitted."

units.zh: 二年春。
units.en: In the spring of the second year.
units.literal: In the spring of the second year.

units.zh: 左拾遺李同上言：「天下系囚，請委長吏逐旬親自引問，質其罪狀真虛，然後論之以法，庶無枉濫。」
units.en: Left Reminder Li Tong proposed: "Prisoners throughout the realm should be summoned and questioned in person by chief officials every ten-day period, their charges verified as true or false, and only then judged by law, so that no wrongful abuse occurs."
units.literal: Left Reminder Li Tong memorialized: "Prisoners throughout the realm—we request that chief officials be commissioned each ten-day period personally to summon and question them, verify whether their charges are true or false, and only then judge them by law, so that there may be no wrongful abuse."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court approved.
units.literal: The proposal was approved.

units.zh: 六月，大理少卿王郁上言：「凡決極刑，合三覆奏，近年以來，全不守此。
units.en: In the sixth month, Vice Minister of Justice Wang Yu reported: "Whenever the death penalty is imposed, three review memorials are required, yet in recent years this rule has not been observed at all.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Vice Minister of Justice Wang Yu memorialized: "Whenever the extreme penalty is decided, there should be three review memorials; in recent years this has not been observed at all.

units.zh: 伏乞今後前一日令各一覆奏。」
units.en: We ask that henceforth one review memorial be submitted on the day before execution."
units.literal: We bow and request that henceforth on the day before, one review memorial each be ordered."

units.zh: 奉敕宜依。
units.en: The edict approved the request.
units.literal: Receiving the edict, approval was granted.

units.zh: 八月，西京奏：「奉近敕，在京犯極刑者，令決前一日各一覆奏，緣當府地遠，此後凡有極刑，不審準條疏覆奏。」
units.en: In the eighth month, the Western Capital reported: "Under the recent edict, those sentenced to death in the capital must have one review memorial on the day before execution. Because our prefecture is far away, we are unsure whether the same rule applies here whenever a death sentence is imposed."
units.literal: In the eighth month, the Western Capital memorialized: "Receiving the recent edict that those who commit the extreme penalty in the capital are to have one review memorial each on the day before execution—because this prefecture is far away, hereafter whenever there is the extreme penalty, we are unsure whether to follow the article and submit a review memorial."

units.zh: 奉敕旨：「昨六月二十日所降敕文，只為應在洛京有犯極刑者覆奏，其諸道已降旨命，準舊例施行。
units.en: The imperial response stated: "The edict of the twentieth day of the sixth month applied only to death sentences in Luoyang. The circuits have already received orders to follow the former precedent.
units.literal: Receiving the edict: "The edict issued on the twentieth day of the sixth month was only for those who commit the extreme penalty in Luoyang to submit review memorials; the circuits have already received imperial orders to follow the former precedent.

units.zh: 今詳西京所奏，尚未明近敕，兼慮諸道有此疑惑，故令曉諭。」
units.en: The Western Capital's memorial shows that the recent edict is still unclear, and the circuits may share the same doubt; clarification is therefore ordered."
units.literal: Now examining the Western Capital's memorial, the recent edict is still not clear, and fearing that the circuits may have this same doubt, we therefore order clarification."

units.zh: 十月辛丑，德音：「為政之要，切在無私；
units.en: On the day xinchou of the tenth month, a gracious edict declared: "The heart of government lies in impartiality;
units.literal: On the day xinchou of the tenth month, a gracious edict stated: "The essential of governing lies in being without selfishness;

units.zh: 聽訟之方，惟期不濫。
units.en: in hearing suits, the sole aim is to avoid abuse.
units.literal: the method of hearing suits looks only to avoiding abuse.

units.zh: 天下諸州府官員，如有善推疑獄及曾雪冤濫兼有異政者，當具姓名聞奏，別加甄獎。」
units.en: Officials in every prefecture who skillfully investigate doubtful cases, clear wrongful convictions, or otherwise distinguish themselves in office shall have their names reported to the throne for special reward."
units.literal: Officials of all prefectures throughout the realm who are skilled in investigating doubtful cases, or who have cleared wrongful abuse and moreover have outstanding administration, shall have their names reported in memorial, and receive separate selection and reward."

units.zh: 長興元年二月，制曰：「欲通和氣，必在伸冤；
units.en: In the second month of the first year of Changxing, an imperial pronouncement declared: "To spread harmony through the realm, wrongs must be redressed;
units.literal: In the second month of the first year of Changxing, an imperial pronouncement stated: "To extend harmonious qi, one must redress wrongs;

units.zh: 將設公方，實資獎善。
units.en: to uphold public justice truly depends on rewarding the good.
units.literal: to establish public rectitude truly relies on rewarding the good.

units.zh: 州縣官僚能雪冤獄活人生命者，許非時選，仍加階超資註官，與轉服色，已著緋者與轉兼官。」
units.en: Prefectural and county officials who clear wrongful cases and save lives may be selected out of season, advanced in rank beyond quota, granted a change of robe color, and those already wearing scarlet may receive a concurrent appointment."
units.literal: Prefectural and county officials who can clear wrongful cases and preserve human life are permitted selection out of season, and further granted advancement in rank, registration beyond quota, change of robe color, and those already wearing scarlet are granted transfer to concurrent office."

units.zh: 二年二月辛亥，敕：「朕猥以眇躬，薦承鴻業，念彼疲瘵，勞於寐興。
units.en: On the day xinhai of the second month of the second year, an edict declared: "We, unworthy in our slight person, have inherited the great enterprise and think constantly of the weary and afflicted, toiling from sleep to rising.
units.literal: On the day xinhai of the second month of the second year, an edict stated: "We, mean in our slight person, have inherited the great enterprise, thinking of the weary and afflicted, toiling from sleep to rising.

units.zh: 或慮官不得人，因成紊亂；
units.en: We fear that when offices do not obtain the right men, disorder follows;
units.literal: We fear that when offices do not obtain the right men, disorder thereby arises;

units.zh: 或慮刑非其罪，遂至怨嗟。
units.en: or that when punishment does not fit the crime, resentment and lament follow.
units.literal: or that when punishment does not match the crime, complaint and lament follow.

units.zh: 王化所興，獄訟為本，茍無訓勵，必有滯淹。
units.en: Royal transformation rests on lawsuits as its foundation; without instruction and encouragement, delays and detentions are inevitable.
units.literal: Where royal transformation rises, lawsuits are the foundation; if there is no instruction and encouragement, there must be delay and detention.

units.zh: 近日諸道百姓，或諸多違犯，或小可鬥爭。
units.en: Recently among the people of the circuits, some commit many offences and others petty quarrels.
units.literal: Recently among the people of the circuits, some have many violations, some petty quarrels.

units.zh: 官吏曲縱胥徒，巧求瑕釁。
units.en: Officials bend the rules to indulge their clerks and runners, ingeniously hunting for pretexts.
units.literal: Officials bend the rules to indulge clerks and runners, ingeniously seeking flaws.

units.zh: 初則滋張節目，作法拘囚；
units.en: At first they multiply charges and devise ways to detain prisoners;
units.literal: At first they multiply articles and devise methods to detain prisoners;

units.zh: 終則誅剝貨財，市恩出拔。
units.en: in the end they extort wealth and trade favors for release.
units.literal: in the end they extort goods and wealth, trading favor for release.

units.zh: 外憑公道，內循私情，無理者轉務遷延，有理者卻思退縮。
units.en: Outwardly they invoke public justice while inwardly they follow private feeling: the party without merit sees the case ever delayed, while the party in the right thinks only of giving up.
units.literal: Outwardly relying on public justice, inwardly following private feeling—those without reason become ever more delayed, while those with reason think of withdrawing.

units.zh: 積成訛弊，漸失紀綱。
units.en: Such abuses pile up until standards are gradually lost.
units.literal: Abuses accumulate and standards are gradually lost.

units.zh: 自今後切委逐處官吏州牧縣宰等，深體余懷，各舉爾職。
units.en: Henceforth we earnestly charge every prefect, county magistrate, and local official to take our intent to heart and perform his proper duty.
units.literal: From now on we earnestly commission the officials everywhere, prefects and county magistrates alike, deeply to embody our intent and each perform his duty.

units.zh: 凡闕推究，速與剸裁。
units.en: Where investigation is lacking, cases are to be judged and decided at once.
units.literal: Wherever investigation is lacking, speedily judge and decide.

units.zh: 如敢茍縱依違，遂成枉濫，或經臺訴屈，或投匭申冤，勘問不虛，其元推官典並當責罰，其逐處觀察使、刺史，別議朝典。
units.en: If any official negligently indulges wrongdoing or acts equivocally and thereby causes wrongful abuse, or if a complaint to the Censorate or an appeal through the grievance box proves true on investigation, the original investigating officials and clerks shall all be punished, and the surveillance commissioners and prefects of each place shall be dealt with under court statute.
units.literal: If any dare negligently indulge or act equivocally and thereby cause wrongful abuse, or if complaint reaches the Censorate of injustice, or appeal is made through the grievance box, and investigation proves true, the original investigating officials and clerks shall all be punished, and the surveillance commissioners and prefects of each place shall be separately judged by court statute.

units.zh: 宜令諸道州府，各依此處分，所管屬郡，委本道嚴切指揮。」
units.en: Every circuit prefecture is to handle matters under this rule, and subordinate commanderies are to be placed under strict direction by their circuit."
units.literal: It is fitting to order the prefectures of all circuits each to handle matters according to this disposition, and the subordinate commanderies under their jurisdiction are entrusted to their circuit for strict direction."

units.zh: 八月丁卯，敕：「三京、諸道州府刑獄，近日訪聞，依前禁系人，多不旋決，諸道宜令所在各委長吏，專切推窮，不得有滯淹。」
units.en: On the day dingmao of the eighth month, an edict ordered: "In the prisons of the three capitals and every circuit, inquiry shows that detainees are still, as before, often not promptly decided. Each circuit should charge local chief officials to investigate with special urgency and allow no delay."
units.literal: On the day dingmao of the eighth month, an edict stated: "In the prisons of the three capitals and the prefectures of all circuits, we have recently learned on inquiry that, as before, detained persons are in many cases not promptly decided; the circuits should order each locality to commission chief officials to investigate with special urgency and permit no delay."

units.zh: 四月，前濮州錄事參軍崔琮上言：「諸道獄囚，恐不依法拷掠，或不勝苦致斃，翻以病聞，請置病囚院，兼加醫藥。」
units.en: In the fourth month, former Recorder Cui Cong of Puzhou proposed: "Prisoners in the circuits may not be tortured according to law, or may die under torture and be reported as having died of illness. We ask that a ward for sick prisoners be established and medicine provided."
units.literal: In the fourth month, former Recorder of Puzhou Cui Cong memorialized: "Prisoners in the circuits may fear that beating and torture are not applied according to law, or that unable to bear suffering they die, which is then reported as illness; we request establishment of a ward for sick prisoners, together with provision of medicine."

units.zh: 中書覆云：「有罪當刑，仰天無恨；
units.en: The Secretariat replied: "When the guilty are punished, they may look to Heaven without complaint;
units.literal: The Secretariat replied: "When guilty one should be punished, and looking to Heaven one has no complaint;

units.zh: 無病致斃，沒地銜冤。
units.en: but to die without illness is to go to the grave bearing a grievance.
units.literal: to die without illness is to go to the ground bearing grievance.

units.zh: 燃死灰而必在至仁，照覆盆而須資異鑒。
units.en: To rekindle dead ashes requires supreme benevolence; to illuminate an overturned basin requires extraordinary discernment.
units.literal: To rekindle dead ashes surely requires supreme benevolence; to illuminate an overturned basin requires extraordinary discernment.

units.zh: 《書》著『欽哉』之旨，『《禮》』標『侀也』之文，因彰善於泣辜，更推恩於扇暍。
units.en: The Documents sets forth the purport of 'Be reverent!'; the Rites marks the text 'Pity them'—thereby goodness is shown in weeping for the wrongfully punished, and favor is extended in relieving those overcome by heat.
units.literal: The Documents sets forth the purport of 'Be reverent!'; the Rites marks the text 'Pity them'; thereby goodness is displayed in weeping for the wrongfully punished, and favor is further extended in fanning the overheated.

units.zh: 所請置病囚院，望依，仍委長吏，專切經心。
units.en: The request for a ward for sick prisoners is approved, and chief officials are charged to attend to it with special care.
units.literal: The request to establish a ward for sick prisoners is approved; chief officials are further commissioned to attend to it with special care.

units.zh: 或有病囚，當時遣醫人診候，治療後，據所犯輕重決斷。
units.en: When prisoners fall ill, physicians are to examine them at once; after treatment, sentence is to be passed according to the severity of the offence.
units.literal: When there are sick prisoners, physicians shall at once be sent to examine them; after treatment, sentence shall be passed according to the severity of the offence.

units.zh: 如敢故違，致病囚負屈身亡，本處官吏，並加嚴斷。
units.en: If any deliberately violate this and cause sick prisoners to die bearing a grievance, the local officials shall all receive severe punishment.
units.literal: If any dare deliberately violate this and cause sick prisoners to die bearing grievance, the local officials shall all receive severe sentence.

units.zh: 兼每及夏至，五日一度，差人洗刷枷匣。」
units.en: Moreover, at the summer solstice, every five days persons are to be assigned to wash the cangues and fetters."
units.literal: Moreover, whenever the summer solstice arrives, every five days persons shall be assigned to wash the cangues and fetters."

units.zh: 應順元年二月戊午，詔：「應三京、諸道州府系囚，據罪輕重，疾速斷遣。
units.en: In the second month of the first year of Yingshun, on the day wuwu, an imperial pronouncement ordered: "All prisoners in the three capitals and every circuit are to be sentenced and released at once according to the severity of the crime.
units.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yingshun, on the day wuwu, an imperial pronouncement stated: "All prisoners detained in the three capitals and the prefectures of all circuits shall, according to the severity of the crime, be speedily sentenced and released.

units.zh: 比來停滯，須奏取裁，不便區分，故為留滯。
units.en: Cases have recently stalled because every decision required a memorial for imperial approval, making timely distinction impossible and causing prolonged detention.
units.literal: Recently cases have stalled because memorials must be submitted for imperial decision, making it inconvenient to distinguish cases, and therefore they are detained.

units.zh: 今後凡有刑獄，據理斷遣。
units.en: Henceforth all criminal cases are to be decided and disposed of on their merits.
units.literal: Henceforth, whenever there are criminal cases, they shall be decided and released according to reason.

units.zh: 如有敕推按，理合奏聞，不在此限。」
units.en: Where an edict orders a special investigation, memorial and report remain required; such cases are outside this rule."
units.literal: If there is an edict ordering investigation, it is proper to memorialize and report, and such cases are outside this limit."

units.zh: 清泰元年五月丁丑，詔：「在京諸獄及天下州府見系罪人，正當暑毒之時，未免拘囚之苦，誠知負罪，特軫予懷。
units.en: In the fifth month of the first year of Qingtai, on the day dingchou, an imperial pronouncement declared: "Prisoners now held in the capital and throughout the realm, at this season of oppressive heat, cannot escape the suffering of confinement. Though they are guilty, we are especially moved.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Qingtai, on the day dingchou, an imperial pronouncement stated: "Prisoners now detained in the capital prisons and in prefectures throughout the realm, at this season of oppressive heat, cannot avoid the suffering of confinement; though they are truly guilty, we are especially moved in our heart.

units.zh: 恐法吏生情，滯於決斷。
units.en: We fear that judicial officers may act on private feeling and delay judgment.
units.literal: We fear that judicial officers may act on private feeling and delay in deciding.

units.zh: 詔至，所在長吏親自慮問，據輕重疾速斷遣，無淹滯。」
units.en: When the pronouncement arrives, chief officials everywhere are to examine prisoners in person and sentence them at once according to severity, without delay."
units.literal: When the pronouncement arrives, the chief officials of each place shall personally examine them, and according to severity speedily sentence and release them, without delay."

units.zh: 晉天福二年八月，敕下刑部大理寺御史臺及三京、諸道州府：「今後或有系囚染疾者，並令逐處軍醫看候，於公廨錢內量支藥價，或事輕者，仍許家人看候。」
units.en: In the eighth month of the second year of Tianfu, an edict went to the Ministry of Justice, Court of Judicial Review, Censorate, the three capitals, and every circuit: "Henceforth when detained prisoners fall ill, local military physicians are to attend them and medicine costs are to be paid from public funds; in light cases family members may still attend."
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Tianfu of Jin, an edict was issued to the Ministry of Justice, Court of Judicial Review, Censorate, three capitals, and prefectures of all circuits: "Henceforth whenever detained prisoners fall ill, military physicians in each place shall be ordered to attend them, and medicine costs shall be allotted from public-office funds; in light cases, family members may still be permitted to attend."

units.zh: 四年九月，相州節度使桑維翰奏：「管內所獲賊人，從來籍沒財產，雲是鄴都舊例，格律未見明文。」
units.en: In the ninth month of the fourth year, Military Governor Sang Weihan of Xiangzhou reported: "Thieves captured in my jurisdiction have always had their property confiscated, said to be an old precedent of the Yedu capital, but no explicit provision appears in the statutes and regulations."
units.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year, Military Governor of Xiangzhou Sang Weihan memorialized: "Thieves captured within my jurisdiction have always had their property confiscated, said to be the old precedent of the Yedu capital, but no explicit text is seen in statutes and regulations."

units.zh: 敕：「今後凡有賊人，準格定罪，不得沒納家資。
units.en: An edict ordered: "Henceforth all thieves are to be sentenced under the regulations, and household property must not be confiscated.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Henceforth all thieves shall be sentenced according to regulations, and household property must not be confiscated.

units.zh: 天下諸州，準此處分。」
units.en: All prefectures throughout the realm are to follow this rule."
units.literal: All prefectures throughout the realm shall follow this disposition."

units.zh: 三月庚午，詳定院奏：「前守洪洞縣主簿盧燦進策云：『伏以刑獄至重，朝廷所難，尚書省分職六司，天下謂之會府，且諸道決獄，若關人命，即刑部不合不知。
units.en: In the third month, on the day gengwu, the Court of Detailed Review reported: "Former Acting Magistrate Lu Can of Hongtong County submitted a policy proposal: 'Criminal cases are supremely weighty and difficult for the court. The Department of State Affairs divides duties among six bureaus and is called the capital office of the realm. When circuits decide cases involving human life, the Ministry of Justice ought not to be kept uninformed.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day gengwu, the Court of Detailed Review memorialized: "Former Acting Magistrate of Hongtong County Lu Can submitted a policy proposal stating: 'We submit that criminal cases are supremely weighty and difficult for the court; the Department of State Affairs divides duties among six bureaus and is called the capital office of the realm; moreover, when circuits decide cases involving human life, the Ministry of Justice ought not to be kept uninformed.

units.zh: 欲請州府凡斷大辟罪人訖，逐季具有無申報刑部，仍俱錄案款事節，並本判官、馬步都虞候、司法參軍、法直官、馬步司判官名銜申聞，所貴或有案內情曲不圓，刑部可行覆勘。
units.en: We ask that whenever a prefecture sentences a capital offender, each quarter it report whether the Ministry of Justice has been notified, and submit the full facts of the case together with the names and titles of the judging official, chief commander of cavalry and infantry, judicial aide, legal rectifier, and cavalry and infantry judges, so that if the circumstances are incomplete the Ministry of Justice may conduct a review.
units.literal: We request that whenever prefectures finish sentencing capital offenders, each quarter they report whether or not they have notified the Ministry of Justice, and also record in full the facts and circumstances of the case, together with the names and titles of the original judging official, chief commander of cavalry and infantry, judicial aide, legal rectifier, and cavalry and infantry judging officials and report them, so that if the circumstances within a case are incomplete, the Ministry of Justice may conduct a review investigation.

units.zh: 如此則天下遵守法律，不敢輕易刑書，非惟免有銜冤，抑亦勸其立政者。』
units.en: Thus the realm will observe the law and not lightly apply the penal code—not only avoiding wrongful grievance, but also encouraging sound administration.'
units.literal: Thus the realm will observe the law and not lightly apply the penal code—not only avoiding wrongful grievance, but also encouraging those who establish administration.'

units.zh: 臣等參詳，伏以人命至重，國法須精，雖載舊章，更宜條理，誠為允當，望賜施行。」
units.en: We have examined this proposal and find that human life is supremely weighty and state law must be precise. Though old regulations touch on the matter, further ordering is appropriate. We ask that it be granted for implementation."
units.literal: Your subjects have examined this in detail and submit that human life is supremely weighty and state law must be precise; although old regulations record this, it should further be set in order; it is truly appropriate, and we hope it may be granted for implementation."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court approved.
units.literal: Approval was granted.

units.zh: 五月，詔曰：「刑獄之難，古今所重，但關人命，實動天心，或有冤魂，則傷和氣。
units.en: In the fifth month, an imperial pronouncement declared: "The difficulty of criminal cases has been weighty in every age. Whenever human life is involved, it truly moves the heart of Heaven; wronged souls harm harmonious qi.
units.literal: In the fifth month, an imperial pronouncement stated: "The difficulty of criminal cases is weighty in past and present; whenever human life is involved, it truly moves the heart of Heaven; if there are wronged souls, harmonious qi is harmed.

units.zh: 應諸道州府，凡有囚徒，據推勘到案款，一一盡理，子細檢律令格敕。
units.en: In every circuit prefecture, for all prisoners the facts reached by investigation are to be fully reasoned through and the statutes, ordinances, and regulations carefully examined.
units.literal: In all prefectures of the circuits, whenever there are prisoners, according to the facts reached by investigation, each point shall be fully reasoned and the statutes, ordinances, and regulations carefully examined.

units.zh: 其間或有疑者，準令文讞，大理寺亦疑，申尚書省，省寺明有指歸，州府然後決遣。」
units.en: Where doubt remains, judgment follows the ordinance text; if the Court of Judicial Review also doubts, the case is memorialized to the Department of State Affairs; only when the department and court give clear direction may the prefecture decide and release."
units.literal: If among them there are doubtful points, follow the ordinance text for judgment; if the Court of Judicial Review also doubts, memorialize the Department of State Affairs; when the department and court have clear direction, the prefecture may then decide and release."

units.zh: 五年三月丙子，詔曰：「自大中六年已來，嫠耳稱冤，決杖流配，訴雖有理，不在申明。
units.en: In the third month of the fifth year, on the day bingzi, an imperial pronouncement declared: "Since the sixth year of Dazhong, widows who pierced their ears to proclaim grievance were sentenced to beating and exile; though their appeals had merit, this was not clarified.
units.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, on the day bingzi, an imperial pronouncement stated: "Since the sixth year of Dazhong, widows who pierced their ears to proclaim grievance were sentenced to beating with the staff and exile; though their appeals had merit, this was not declared for clarification.

units.zh: 今後據其所陳，與為勘斷，剺耳之罪，準律別科。」
units.en: Henceforth their statements are to be investigated and judged on their merits, and the offence of ear-slitting is to be sentenced separately under the statutes."
units.literal: Henceforth, according to what they state, investigation and judgment shall be conducted for them; the offence of ear-slitting shall be sentenced separately according to the statutes."

units.zh: 六年秋七月庚辰，詔曰：「政教所切，獄訟惟先，推窮須察於事情，斷遣必遵於條法，用宏欽恤，以致和平。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn of the sixth year, on the day gengchen, an imperial pronouncement declared: "Government and instruction require that lawsuits come first. Investigation must observe the facts, and judgment must follow the articles of law, thereby extending compassionate rule to achieve peace.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn of the sixth year, on the day gengchen, an imperial pronouncement stated: "What government and instruction require is that lawsuits come first; investigation must observe the facts of the case, and judgment and release must follow the articles of law, thereby extending reverent compassion to achieve peace.

units.zh: 應三京、鄴都及諸道州府，見禁諸色人等，宜令逐處長吏，常切提撕，疾速決遣，每務公當，勿使滯淹。」
units.en: In the three capitals, Yedu, and every circuit, all persons now detained are to be urged with constant care by local chief officials, speedily tried and released with fairness, and not held in delay."
units.literal: In the three capitals, Yedu, and the prefectures of all circuits, all persons now detained of every kind should have local chief officials constantly urge them with special care, speedily decide and release them, always striving for fairness, and not permit delay."

units.zh: 天福八年四月壬申，敕：「朕自臨寰宇，思致和平，思將以四海為家，慮有一物失所。
units.en: In the fourth month of the eighth year of Tianfu, on the day renshen, an edict declared: "Since We assumed rule over the realm, We have sought peace, thinking to make the four seas Our household and fearing that even one being may lose its proper place.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year of Tianfu, on the day renshen, an edict stated: "We, since assuming rule over the realm, have thought to bring peace, thinking to make the four seas our household and fearing that even one being may lose its proper place.

units.zh: 每念狴牢之內，或多枉撓之人，屬此炎蒸，倍宜軫憫，冀絕滯淹之嘆，用資欽恤之仁。
units.en: We constantly think of those in prison, among whom many may have been wrongfully oppressed. At this season of blazing heat compassion is doubly fitting, in the hope of ending the lament of delay and embodying compassionate rule.
units.literal: We constantly think of those within the prisons, among whom many may have been wrongfully oppressed; at this season of blazing heat, compassion is doubly fitting, in the hope of ending the lament of delay and detention and supplying the benevolence of reverent compassion.

units.zh: 應三京、鄴都及諸道州府見禁罪人等，宜令逐處長吏，嚴切指揮本推司及委本所判官，疾速結絕斷遣，不得淹延，及致冤濫，仍付所司。」
units.en: All offenders now detained in the three capitals, Yedu, and every circuit are to be placed under strict direction by local chief officials, who shall charge investigating offices and judging officials to conclude cases and sentence at once without delay or wrongful abuse. The responsible offices are charged with enforcement."
units.literal: All offenders now detained in the three capitals, Yedu, and the prefectures of all circuits should have local chief officials strictly direct the investigating offices and commission the judging officials of each place to conclude and sentence speedily, without delay that leads to wrongful abuse, and this is further entrusted to the responsible offices."

units.zh: 開運二年五月壬戌，殿中丞桑簡能上封事曰：「伏以天地育萬物，廣博厚之恩；
units.en: In the fifth month of the second year of Kaiyun, on the day renxu, Palace Director Sang Jianneng submitted a sealed memorial: "Heaven and Earth nurture the ten thousand things with broad and generous favor;
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Kaiyun, on the day renxu, Palace Director Sang Jianneng submitted a sealed memorial stating: "We submit that Heaven and Earth nurture the ten thousand things with broad, generous, and thick favor;

units.zh: 帝王牧黎元，行寬大之令。
units.en: emperors shepherd the people and issue lenient orders.
units.literal: emperors shepherd the black-haired people and issue lenient orders.

units.zh: 是知恤刑緩獄，乃為政之先；
units.en: Hence tempering punishment and easing prisons is the first priority of government;
units.literal: From this we know that tempering punishment and easing prisons is the first priority of government;

units.zh: 布德行惠，實愛民之本。
units.en: and dispensing virtue and extending favor is truly the root of loving the people.
units.literal: dispensing virtue and extending favor is truly the root of loving the people.

units.zh: 今盛夏之月，農事方殷，是雷風長養之時，乃動植蕃蕪之際。
units.en: Now in the height of summer agricultural work is at its peak; this is the season when thunder and wind nurture growth, when all living things flourish.
units.literal: Now in the month of full summer, agricultural work is at its height; this is the season when thunder and wind nurture growth, the time when moving and rooted beings flourish abundantly.

units.zh: 宜順時令，以宏至仁。
units.en: It is fitting to follow the seasonal order and extend supreme benevolence.
units.literal: It is fitting to follow the seasonal order and extend supreme benevolence.

units.zh: 竊以諸道州府都郡縣應見禁罪人，或有久在囹圄，稍滯區分，胥吏侮文，枝蔓乃眾。
units.en: Among offenders now detained in prefectures, commanderies, and counties of every circuit, some have long been in prison while judgment is delayed, clerks despise the written law, and cases branch into ever more extensions.
units.literal: We venture to consider that among offenders now detained in prefectures, commanderies, and counties of all circuits, some have long been in prison, judgment is slightly delayed, clerks and runners despise the written law, and branching extensions become numerous.

units.zh: 捶楚之下。
units.en: Under beating and flogging,
units.literal: Under beating and flogging,

units.zh: 或陷無辜；
units.en: some are driven into false guilt;
units.literal: some are driven into false guilt;

units.zh: 縲紲之中，莫能自理。
units.en: and within fetters none can clear themselves.
units.literal: within fetters and bonds none can clear themselves.

units.zh: 茍一人拘系，則數人營財，物用既殫，工業亦罷。
units.en: When one person is detained, several raise funds for his release; goods are exhausted and crafts cease.
units.literal: If one person is detained, then several persons raise funds; goods are exhausted and crafts cease.

units.zh: 若此之類，實繁有徒，切恐官吏因循，浸成斯弊。
units.en: Such cases are truly numerous, and we deeply fear that perfunctory officials will gradually entrench this abuse.
units.literal: Cases of this kind are truly numerous; we deeply fear that officials, acting perfunctorily, will gradually entrench this abuse.

units.zh: 伏乞降詔旨，令所在刑獄，委長吏親自錄問，量罪疾速斷遣，務絕冤濫，勿得淹留，庶免虛禁平人，妨奪農力，冀召和氣，以慶明時。」
units.en: We ask that an edict order chief officials in every prison to question prisoners in person, sentence according to the crime and release them at once, end wrongful abuse, and permit no detention, so that innocent commoners are not falsely imprisoned, agricultural labor is not hindered, and harmonious qi may bless this enlightened age."
units.literal: We bow and request that an edict be issued ordering the prisons in each place to have chief officials personally record and question prisoners, sentence according to the crime and speedily release them, striving to end wrongful abuse and permit no detention, so that innocent commoners are not falsely imprisoned, agricultural labor is not hindered, and harmonious qi may be summoned to celebrate this enlightened age."

units.zh: 敕曰：「囹圄之中，縲紲之苦，奸吏茍窮於枝蔓，平人用費於貨財，由茲滯淹，兼致屈塞。
units.en: An edict replied: "Within prisons, the suffering of fetters—corrupt officials negligently multiply procedural extensions, and common people expend their wealth; thereby delay arises and injustice follows.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Within prisons, the suffering of fetters—corrupt officials negligently exhaust cases in branching extensions, and common people expend wealth; thereby delay and detention arise, and obstruction follows as well.

units.zh: 桑簡能體茲軫憫，專有敷陳，請長吏躬親，免獄官抑逼，深為允當，宜再頌行。
units.en: Sang Jian has embodied this compassionate concern in his proposal that chief officials attend in person and spare prisoners from oppressive pressure by prison officers. This is deeply appropriate and should again be proclaimed for enforcement.
units.literal: Sang Jian embodies this compassionate concern and has set it forth exclusively; requesting that chief officials attend in person and spare prisoners from oppressive pressure by prison officers is deeply appropriate and should again be proclaimed for enforcement.

units.zh: 宜依。」
units.en: Approved."
units.literal: Approval is granted."

units.zh: 十月甲子，秘書省著作郎邊玕上封事曰：「臣聞從諫如流，人君之令範；
units.en: In the tenth month, on the day jiazi, Author Bian Gan of the Secretariat submitted a sealed memorial: "I have heard that accepting remonstrance like flowing water is the ruler's model;
units.literal: In the tenth month, on the day jiazi, Author in the Secretariat Bian Gan submitted a sealed memorial stating: "Your subject has heard that accepting remonstrance like flowing water is the ruler's model;

units.zh: 極言無隱，臣子之常規。
units.en: and speaking to the utmost without concealment is the minister's constant rule.
units.literal: speaking to the utmost without concealment is the minister's constant rule.

units.zh: 蓋欲表大國之任人，致萬邦之無事，前文備載，可舉而行。
units.en: This displays how a great state employs men and brings the realm to peace; former texts record it fully and it may be put into practice.
units.literal: This is meant to display how a great state employs men and brings the ten thousand regions to peace; former texts record this fully and it may be raised up and put into practice.

units.zh: 伏以皇帝陛下，德合上玄，運膺下武，旰食宵衣而軫念，好生惡殺以推仁，幾措典刑，固無冤枉。
units.en: Your Majesty's virtue accords with Heaven and your destiny received the martial mandate. Rising early and retiring late, you are moved by concern, loving life and hating killing as you extend benevolence. Punishments are scarcely applied, and wrongful conviction is inherently absent.
units.literal: We submit that Your Majesty's virtue accords with the Supreme Heaven and your destiny received the martial below; rising early and retiring late you are moved in concern, loving life and hating killing you extend benevolence; punishments are scarcely applied, and wrongful conviction is inherently absent.

units.zh: 然以照臨之內，州郡尤多，若不再具舉明，伏恐漸成奸弊。
units.en: Yet within the realm you illuminate, prefectures and commanderies are especially numerous; if this is not set forth again in detail, abuses may gradually arise.
units.literal: Yet within the realm illuminated by your grace, prefectures and commanderies are especially numerous; if this is not again set forth in detail, we fear abuses will gradually arise.

units.zh: 臣竊見諸道刑獄，前朝曾降敕文，凡是禁系罪人，五日一度錄問。
units.en: I observe that in the prisons of the circuits, the former court once ordered that all detained offenders be recorded and questioned once every five days.
units.literal: Your subject has observed that in the prisons of the circuits, the former court once issued an edict that all detained offenders should be recorded and questioned once every five days.

units.zh: 但以年月稍遠，漸致因循。
units.en: But as years have passed, perfunctory neglect has gradually set in.
units.literal: But as years and months have grown somewhat distant, perfunctory neglect has gradually set in.

units.zh: 或長吏事煩，不暇躬親點檢；
units.en: Sometimes chief officials, overwhelmed with affairs, have no leisure to inspect in person;
units.literal: Sometimes chief officials, busy with affairs, have no leisure to inspect in person;

units.zh: 或胥徒啟幸，妄要追領證明。
units.en: sometimes clerks seize opportunity and wantonly demand pursuit and summoning of witnesses.
units.literal: sometimes clerks and runners seize opportunity and wantonly demand pursuit and summoning of witnesses.

units.zh: 慮有涉於淫刑，即恐傷於和氣。
units.en: We fear that excessive punishment may be involved, which would harm harmonious qi.
units.literal: We fear that excessive punishment may be involved, which would harm harmonious qi.

units.zh: 伏乞特降詔敕。
units.en: We ask that a special edict be issued.
units.literal: We bow and request that a special edict be issued.

units.zh: 自今後諸道並委長吏五日一度，當面同共錄問，所冀處法者無恨，銜冤者獲伸。
units.en: Henceforth in every circuit chief officials are to record and question prisoners together face to face once every five days, so that those punished by law have no resentment and those bearing grievance obtain redress.
units.literal: From now on in all circuits chief officials are to record and question prisoners together face to face once every five days, in the hope that those punished by law will have no resentment and those bearing grievance will obtain redress.

units.zh: 俾令四海九州，鹹歌聖德；
units.en: Thus the four seas and nine regions may all sing of sagely virtue;
units.literal: Thus causing the four seas and nine regions all to sing of sagely virtue;

units.zh: 五風十雨，永致昌期。」
units.en: with timely winds and rain, ever reaching an age of prosperity."
units.literal: with five winds and timely rain, ever reaching an age of prosperity."

units.zh: 敕曰：「人之命無以復生，國之刑不可濫舉。
units.en: An edict replied: "Human life, once lost, cannot be restored; the state's punishments must not be applied at will.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Human life, once lost, cannot be restored; the state's punishments must not be applied at will.

units.zh: 雖一成之典，務在公平；
units.en: Though the law is fixed, fairness must be pursued;
units.literal: Though the law is fixed, fairness must be pursued;

units.zh: 而三覆其詞，所宜詳審。
units.en: and the threefold review of testimony should be conducted with thorough examination.
units.literal: and the threefold review of testimony should be conducted with thorough examination.

units.zh: 凡居法吏，合究獄情。
units.en: All judicial officers should investigate prison circumstances fully.
units.literal: All who hold office in the law should investigate prison circumstances.

units.zh: 邊玕近陟周行，俄陳讜議，更彰欽恤，宜允申明。」
units.en: Bian Gan was recently promoted at court and soon offered loyal counsel that further displays compassionate rule; clarification is approved."
units.literal: Bian Gan was recently promoted in court service and soon offered loyal counsel, further displaying reverent compassion; approval for clarification is granted."

units.zh: 三年十一月丁未，左拾遺竇儼上疏曰：「臣伏睹名例律疏云：死刑者，古先哲王，則天垂象，本欲生之，義期止殺，絞斬之坐，皆刑之極也。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the third year, on the day dingwei, Left Reminder Dou Yan submitted a memorial: "I have read in the commentary on the General Principles Statutes that capital punishment—ancient sage kings, taking Heaven as their model, originally intended to preserve life and aimed to stop killing—makes strangulation and decapitation the extreme of punishment.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, on the day dingwei, Left Reminder Dou Yan submitted a memorial stating: "Your subject has observed that the commentary on the General Principles Statutes says: Capital punishment—ancient sage kings, taking Heaven as their model, originally intended to give life and aimed by principle to stop killing; the penalties of strangulation and decapitation are both the extreme of punishment.

units.zh: 又準天成三年閏八月二十三日敕，行極法日，宜不舉樂，減常膳；
units.en: Further, according to the edict of the twenty-third day of the intercalary eighth month of the third year of Tiancheng, on the day the death penalty is carried out, music should not be performed and regular meals should be reduced;
units.literal: Further, according to the edict of the twenty-third day of the intercalary eighth month of the third year of Tiancheng, on the day the extreme penalty is carried out, music should not be performed and regular meals should be reduced;

units.zh: 又刑部式，決重杖一頓處死，以代極法，斯皆人君哀矜不舍之道也。
units.en: and according to the Ministry of Justice format, death by one heavy beating with the staff in place of the death penalty—all reflect the ruler's compassionate reluctance to take life.
units.literal: and according to the format of the Ministry of Justice, death by one heavy beating with the staff in place of the extreme penalty—all these are the way of the ruler's compassionate reluctance to abandon life.

units.zh: 竊以蚩尤為五虐之科，尚行鞭樸；
units.en: Even Chiyou, who established the five cruel punishments, still applied flogging;
units.literal: We venture to consider that even Chiyou, who established the five cruel punishments, still applied flogging;

units.zh: 漢祖約三章之法，止有死刑。
units.en: and the Han founder's law of three chapters recognized only the death penalty.
units.literal: the Han founder's law of three chapters had only the death penalty.

units.zh: 絞者筋骨相連，斬者頭頸異處，大辟之目，不出兩端，淫刑所興，近聞數等。
units.en: Strangulation leaves sinew and bone connected; decapitation separates head and neck—the categories of capital punishment do not go beyond these two. Yet excessive punishments have recently arisen in several kinds.
units.literal: Strangulation leaves sinew and bone connected; decapitation separates head and neck—the categories of great execution do not go beyond these two ends; excessive punishments that have arisen recently are heard to number several kinds.

units.zh: 蓋緣外地，不守通規，肆率情性，或以長釘貫篸人手足，或以短刀臠割人肌膚，乃至累朝半生半死，俾冤聲而上達，致和氣以有傷。
