units.en: This is because in the outer regions they do not observe the general regulations but indulge their feelings at will—sometimes driving long nails through hands and feet, sometimes cutting flesh with short knives, even leaving persons half alive and half dead, so that cries of grievance reach the throne and harmonious qi is harmed.
units.literal: This is because in outer regions they do not observe the general regulations but indulge their feelings at will, sometimes driving long nails through people's hands and feet, sometimes cutting people's flesh with short knives, even leaving persons half alive and half dead for successive courts, causing cries of grievance to reach above and harming harmonious qi.

units.zh: 將宏守位之仁，在峻惟行之令，欲乞特下明敕，嚴加禁斷者。」
units.en: To extend the benevolence of the throne and enforce the law strictly, we ask that a clear edict be specially issued to prohibit these practices."
units.literal: To extend the benevolence of holding one's position and to enforce strictly the command of carrying out the law, we wish to request that a clear edict be specially issued to prohibit these strictly."

units.zh: 敕曰：「文物方興，刑罰須當，有罪宜從於正法，去邪漸契於古風。
units.en: An edict replied: "Culture and institutions are just rising; punishments must be appropriate. The guilty should be punished under the proper law, and expelling evil should gradually accord with ancient custom.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Culture and institutions are just rising; punishments must be appropriate; the guilty should follow the proper law, and expelling evil gradually accords with ancient custom.

units.zh: 竇儼所貢奏章，實裨理道，宜依所奏，準律令施行。」
units.en: Dou Yan's memorial truly aids good order; it is approved as submitted and is to be carried out according to the statutes and ordinances."
units.literal: The memorial submitted by Dou Yan truly aids the way of good order; approval is granted as memorialized, to be carried out according to statutes and ordinances."

units.zh: 漢乾祐二年正月，敕：「政貴寬易，刑尚哀矜，慮滋蔓之生奸，實軫傷而是念。
units.en: In the first month of the second year of Qianyou of Han, an edict declared: "Government values leniency and ease, and punishment esteems compassion. We fear that unchecked growth breeds wrongdoing and are truly moved in concern.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of Qianyou of Han, an edict stated: "Government values leniency and ease; punishment esteems compassion; we fear that spreading growth breeds wrongdoing, and are truly moved in concern.

units.zh: 今屬三元改候，四序履端，將冀和平，無如獄訟。
units.en: Now at the change of the three origins and the opening of the four seasons, we hope for peace, yet nothing compares to lawsuits.
units.literal: Now at the change of the three origins and the opening of the four seasons, we hope for peace, yet nothing compares to lawsuits.

units.zh: 應三京、鄴都、諸道州府見系罪人，委逐處長吏躬親慮問，其於決斷，務在公平，但見其情，即為具獄，勿令率引，遂致淹停，無縱舞文，有傷和氣。」
units.en: All offenders now detained in the three capitals, Yedu, and every circuit are entrusted to local chief officials for personal examination. In deciding cases, fairness must be pursued—once the circumstances are clear, the case record is complete. Do not permit reckless extension that leads to delay, nor twisting of the written law that harms harmonious qi."
units.literal: All offenders now detained in the three capitals, Yedu, and the prefectures of all circuits are entrusted to local chief officials to examine in person; in deciding cases, fairness must be pursued—once the circumstances are seen, the case record is complete; do not permit reckless extension that leads to delay and detention, nor allow twisting of the written law that harms harmonious qi."

units.zh: 四月甲午，敕曰：「月戒正陽，候當小暑，乃挺重出輕之日，是恤刑議獄之辰，有罪者速就勘窮，薄罰者畫時疏決，用符時令，勿縱滯淹。
units.en: On the day jiawu of the fourth month, an edict declared: "The month warns of upright yang and the season approaches minor heat. This is the day for bringing out the light and removing the heavy, the time for tempering punishment and deliberating cases. The guilty are to be investigated at once, and light punishments tried and released within the day, conforming to the seasonal order without delay.
units.literal: On the day jiawu of the fourth month, an edict stated: "The month warns of upright yang; the season approaches minor heat; this is the day for bringing out the light and removing the heavy, the time for tempering punishment and deliberating cases; the guilty should speedily be investigated to the full, and light punishments should be tried and released within the day, conforming to the seasonal order and not permitting delay.

units.zh: 三京、鄴都、諸道州府在獄見系罪人，宜令所司疾速斷遣，無致淹滯枉濫。」
units.en: Offenders now detained in the three capitals, Yedu, and every circuit are to be sentenced and released at once by the responsible offices, without delay or wrongful abuse."
units.literal: Offenders now detained in prison in the three capitals, Yedu, and the prefectures of all circuits should be ordered by the responsible offices to sentence and release speedily, without causing delay or wrongful abuse."

units.zh: 五月辛未，敕：「政化所先，獄訟攸切，不惟枉撓，兼慮滯淹。
units.en: On the day xinwei of the fifth month, an edict declared: "What government and transformation put first, lawsuits urgently require—not only wrongful oppression, but delay and detention as well.
units.literal: On the day xinwei of the fifth month, an edict stated: "What government and transformation put first, lawsuits urgently require—not only wrongful oppression, but also delay and detention.

units.zh: 適當長養之時，正屬熇蒸之候，累行條貫，俾速施行，靡不丁寧，未曾奏報，再頌告諭，無或因循。
units.en: This aptly falls in the season of nurturing growth and blazing heat. Regulations have repeatedly been issued to speed enforcement with painstaking care, yet memorial reports have never been received. We again proclaim instruction—there must be no perfunctory neglect.
units.literal: This aptly falls in the season of nurturing growth and the period of blazing heat; regulations have repeatedly been issued to speed enforcement, all with painstaking care, yet memorial reports have never been received; we again proclaim instruction and admonition—there must be no perfunctory neglect.

units.zh: 應三京、鄴都、諸道州府，詔至，宜具疏放已行未行申奏，無致逗留」
units.en: In the three capitals, Yedu, and every circuit, when the edict arrives, a detailed account of releases already carried out and not yet carried out is to be memorialized without delay."
units.literal: In the three capitals, Yedu, and the prefectures of all circuits, when the edict arrives, a detailed account of releases already carried out and not yet carried out should be memorialized, without causing delay."

units.zh: 周廣順三年四月乙亥，敕：「朕以時當化育，氣屬炎蒸，乃思縲紲之人，是軫哀矜之念，慮其非所，案鞫淹延，或枉濫窮屈而未得申宣，或饑渴疾病而無所控告。
units.en: On the day yihai of the fourth month of the third year of Guangshun, an edict declared: "As the season is for nurturing transformation and the qi belongs to blazing heat, We think of those in fetters and are moved by compassionate concern. We fear that they are not in their proper place, that case examination is delayed, that some wrongfully oppressed cannot make their grievance known, or that hunger, thirst, and illness leave them with no means of appeal.
units.literal: On the day yihai of the fourth month of the third year of Guangshun of Zhou, an edict stated: "We, as the season is for nurturing transformation and the qi belongs to blazing heat, think of those in fetters and bonds and are moved by compassionate concern, fearing that they are not in their proper place, that case examination is delayed, that some wrongfully oppressed and exhausted cannot make their grievance known, or that hunger, thirst, and illness leave them with no means of appeal.

units.zh: 以罪當刑者，惟彼自召，法不可移；
units.en: Those whose crime deserves punishment have only themselves to blame; the law cannot be shifted;
units.literal: Those whose crime deserves punishment have only themselves to blame; the law cannot be shifted;

units.zh: 非理受苦者，為上不明，安得無慮。
units.en: but those who suffer without reason do so because the ruler above is not clear—how can We not be concerned?
units.literal: those who suffer without reason do so because the ruler above is not clear—how can we not be concerned?

units.zh: 欽恤之道，夙宵靡寧。
units.en: The way of compassionate rule leaves Us uneasy from early morning to late night.
units.literal: The way of reverent compassion leaves us uneasy from early morning to late night.

units.zh: 應諸道州府見系罪人，宜令官吏疾速推鞫，據輕斷遣，不得淹滯。
units.en: All offenders now detained in every circuit are to be investigated at once by officials, sentenced according to severity, and released without delay.
units.literal: All offenders now detained in the prefectures of all circuits should be ordered by officials to investigate speedily, sentence according to severity, and release them, without delay.

units.zh: 仍令獄吏，灑掃牢獄，當令虛歇；
units.en: Prison officers are further ordered to clean the prisons and keep them properly vacant;
units.literal: Prison officers are further ordered to sprinkle and sweep the prisons and keep them properly vacant;

units.zh: 洗滌枷械，無令蚤虱；
units.en: wash the cangues and fetters and permit no fleas or lice;
units.literal: wash the cangues and fetters and do not permit fleas and lice;

units.zh: 供給水漿，無令饑渴。
units.en: supply water and drink and permit no hunger or thirst.
units.literal: supply water and drink and do not permit hunger or thirst.

units.zh: 如有疾患，令其家人看承，囚人無主，官差醫工診候，勿致病亡。
units.en: If prisoners fall ill, their families are to attend them; for those without kin, official physicians are to examine them, and death from disease is not permitted.
units.literal: If there is illness, order their families to attend them; for prisoners without kin, assign physicians to examine them and do not permit death from disease.

units.zh: 循典法之成規，順長嬴之時令，俾無淹滯，以致治平。」
units.en: Following the established regulations of the canonical law and conforming to the seasonal order of full summer, cause there to be no delay, thereby achieving ordered peace."
units.literal: Following the established regulations of the canonical law and conforming to the seasonal order of full summer, cause there to be no delay and detention, thereby achieving ordered peace."

units.zh: 又，賜諸州詔曰：「朕以敷政之勤，惟刑是重，既未能化人於無罪，則不可為上而失刑。
units.en: Further, edicts were sent to the prefectures: "In the diligence of governing, We hold punishment supremely weighty. Having been unable to transform all people into innocence, We cannot as ruler fail to apply the law.
units.literal: Further, edicts were granted to the prefectures stating: "We, in the diligence of spreading government, hold punishment supremely weighty; having been unable to transform people into innocence, we cannot as ruler above fail to apply punishment.

units.zh: 況時當長嬴，事貴清適，念囹圄之閉固，復桎梏之拘縻，處於炎蒸，何異焚灼。
units.en: Moreover, the season is full summer, when clarity and ease are prized. To think of prisons shut fast and shackles binding prisoners in blazing heat is no different from burning them.
units.literal: Moreover, the season is full summer, when affairs value clarity and ease; thinking of the closed solidity of prisons and again the binding restraint of shackles, to be placed in blazing heat is no different from being burned.

units.zh: 在州及所屬刑獄見系罪人，卿可躬親錄問，省略區分。
units.en: For offenders now detained in your prefecture and its subordinate prisons, you may question them in person and abbreviate procedural distinctions.
units.literal: Offenders now detained in the prefecture and its subordinate prisons—you may personally record and question them and abbreviate distinctions.

units.zh: 於入務不行者，令俟務開系；
units.en: Those for whom proceedings cannot proceed during court recess are to await reopening of court;
units.literal: Those for whom proceedings cannot proceed during court recess are to await reopening of court;

units.zh: 有理須伸者，速期疏決。
units.en: those with merit requiring redress are to be tried and released at once.
units.literal: those with merit requiring redress should speedily be tried and released.

units.zh: 俾皆平允，無至滯淹。
units.en: Thus all cases are to be fair and even, without delay.
units.literal: Thus causing all to be fair and even, without reaching delay and detention.

units.zh: 又以獄吏逞任情之奸，囚人被非法之苦，宜加檢察，勿縱侵欺。
units.en: Because prison officers indulge wilful wrongdoing and prisoners suffer unlawful hardship, inspection should be increased and oppression must not be indulged.
units.literal: Further, because prison officers indulge wilful wrongdoing and prisoners suffer unlawful hardship, inspection should be increased and oppression must not be indulged.

units.zh: 常令凈掃獄房，洗刷枷匣，知其饑渴，供與水漿，有病者聽骨肉看承，無主者遣醫工救療，勿令非理致斃，以致和氣有傷。
units.en: Prison rooms are to be kept swept clean and cangues washed; hunger and thirst are to be relieved with water and drink. The ill may be attended by kin; those without kin are to be treated by physicians. Unlawful death that harms harmonious qi is not permitted.
units.literal: Constantly order the prison rooms swept clean, cangues and cases washed, know their hunger and thirst and supply water and drink; when ill, permit kin to attend; when without kin, send physicians to treat them; do not permit unlawful death that harms harmonious qi.

units.zh: 卿忠幹分憂，仁明蒞事，必能奉詔，體我用心，眷委於茲，興寐無已。
units.en: You are loyal and capable in sharing Our cares and benevolent and clear in office—you will surely obey the edict and embody Our intent. In entrusting this commission to you, We think of it waking and sleeping without end.
units.literal: You are loyal and capable in sharing our cares, benevolent and clear in attending to affairs—you will surely be able to obey the edict, embody our intent, and in this commission entrusted to you, we think of it waking and sleeping without end.

units.zh: 余從敕命處分。」
units.en: Act according to the edict."
units.literal: Act according to the edict's disposition."

units.zh: 顯德元年十一月，帝謂侍臣曰：「天下所奏獄訟，多追引證，甚致淹延，有及百餘日而未決者。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the first year of Xiande, the emperor said to his attendants: "Of lawsuits reported throughout the realm, many require pursuing collateral witnesses and testimony, causing serious delays, with some cases unresolved for more than a hundred days.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Xiande, the emperor said to his attendants: "Of lawsuits reported throughout the realm, many require pursuing collateral witnesses and testimony, causing serious delay, with some cases unresolved for more than a hundred days.

units.zh: 其中有徒黨反告者，劫主陳訴者及妄遭牽引者，慮獄吏作幸遲留，致生人休廢活業，朕每念此，彌切疚懷。
units.en: Among them are cases where accomplices lodge counter-accusations, robbery victims bring complaints, and persons are wrongly implicated. I fear prison officers deliberately delay proceedings, causing people to abandon their livelihoods. Whenever I think of this, my guilt grows ever keener.
units.literal: Among them are cases where accomplices lodge counter-accusations, victims robbed bring complaints, and persons are wrongly implicated—I fear prison officers deliberately delay proceedings, causing people to abandon their livelihoods. Whenever I think of this, my sense of guilt grows ever keener.

units.zh: 此後宜條貫所在藩郡，令選明幹僚吏，當其訴訟。
units.en: Henceforth regulations should be drawn up in each feudatory commandery, ordering the selection of capable and competent subordinate officials to handle their lawsuits.
units.literal: Henceforth regulations should be drawn up in each feudatory commandery, ordering the selection of capable and competent subordinate officials to handle their lawsuits.

units.zh: 如獄不滯留，人無枉撓，明具聞奏，量與甄獎。」
units.en: If cases are not detained and no one is wrongfully abused, report this clearly in memorial and grant rewards in appropriate measure."
units.literal: If cases are not detained and no one is wrongfully abused, report this clearly in memorial and grant rewards in appropriate measure."

units.zh: 內外官當贖之法，梁、唐皆無定制，多示優容，或因時分輕重。
units.en: The law of commutation for inner and outer officials—Liang and Tang both lacked fixed regulations, often showing lenient tolerance or distinguishing severity according to circumstances.
units.literal: The law of commutation for inner and outer officials—Liang and Tang both had no fixed regulations, often showing lenient tolerance, or distinguishing severity according to the time.

units.zh: 晉天福六年五月，尚書刑部員外郎李象請：「今後凡是散官，不計高低，若犯罪不得當贖，亦不得上請詳定院覆奏。
units.en: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Tianfu, Vice Director Li Xiang of the Bureau of Punishments requested: "Henceforth all honorary officials, regardless of rank, if they commit crimes may not commute punishment nor petition the Court of Detailed Review for review.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Tianfu of Jin, Vice Director of the Bureau of Punishments in the Department of State Affairs Li Xiang requested: "Henceforth all honorary officials, regardless of rank high or low, if they commit crimes may not commute punishment, nor may they petition the Court of Detailed Review for review memorial.

units.zh: 應內外文武官，有品官者自從品官法，無品官有散試官者，應內外帶職廷臣賓從、有功將校等，並請同九品官例。
units.en: Civil and military officials with ranked offices follow the law for ranked officials. Those without ranked offices who hold honorary or probationary titles—including titled courtiers, guests, attendants, and meritorious commanders—are all to follow the precedent for officials of the ninth rank.
units.literal: For civil and military officials inside and outside, those with ranked offices follow the law for ranked officials; those without ranked offices who have honorary or probationary offices, including courtiers with titles inside and outside, guests and attendants, meritorious commanders and the like, are all requested to follow the precedent for officials of the ninth rank.

units.zh: 其京都運巡使及諸道州府衙前職員、內外雜任鎮將等，並請準律，不得上請當贖。
units.en: Transport and patrol commissioners of the capital, front-office staff of circuit prefectures, miscellaneous appointees, and garrison commanders are all to follow the statutes and may not petition for commutation.
units.literal: As for transport and patrol commissioners of the capital, front-office staff of prefectures in all circuits, miscellaneous appointees and garrison commanders inside and outside, all are requested to follow the statutes and may not petition for commutation.

units.zh: 其巡司馬步司判官，雖有曾歷品官者，亦請同流外職。
units.en: Judging officials of patrol cavalry and infantry offices, even if they have formerly held ranked office, are also to be treated like outer-service posts.
units.literal: As for judging officials of patrol cavalry and infantry offices, even if they have formerly held ranked office, they are also requested to be treated like outer-service posts.

units.zh: 準律。
units.en: According to the statutes.
units.literal: According to the statutes.

units.zh: 杖罪以下，依決罰例，徒罪以上，仍依當贖法。」
units.en: For offences of beating with the staff and below, follow the precedent for imposed punishment; for exile and above, follow the commutation law."
units.literal: For offences of beating with the staff and below, follow the precedent for imposed punishment; for exile and above, still follow the commutation law."

units.zh: 至周顯德五年七月，新定《刑統》：「今後定罪，諸道行軍司馬、節度副使、副留守，準從五品官例；
units.en: By the seventh month of the fifth year of Xiande, the newly fixed Penal Compendium stated: "Henceforth in fixing punishment, circuit army marshals, deputy military governors, and deputy protectors follow the precedent for officials of the fifth rank and below;
units.literal: By the seventh month of the fifth year of Xiande of Zhou, the newly fixed Penal Compendium stated: "Henceforth in fixing punishment, circuit army marshals, deputy military governors, and deputy protectors follow the precedent for officials of the fifth rank and below;

units.zh: 諸道兩使判官、防禦團練副使，準從六品官例；
units.en: circuit commissioners' judging officials and defense and training deputy commissioners follow the precedent for officials of the sixth rank and below;
units.literal: circuit commissioners' judging officials, defense and training deputy commissioners follow the precedent for officials of the sixth rank and below;

units.zh: 節度掌書記、團判官、兩蕃營田等使判官，準從七品官例；
units.en: military governor secretaries, training commissioners' judging officials, and judging officials of frontier garrison and agricultural commissioners follow the precedent for officials of the seventh rank and below;
units.literal: military governor secretaries, training commissioners' judging officials, and judging officials of frontier garrison and agricultural commissioners follow the precedent for officials of the seventh rank and below;

units.zh: 諸道推巡及軍事判官，準從八品官例；
units.en: circuit investigation and military judging officials follow the precedent for officials of the eighth rank and below;
units.literal: circuit investigation and military judging officials follow the precedent for officials of the eighth rank and below;

units.zh: 諸軍將校內諸司使、使副、供奉、殿直，臨時奏聽敕旨。」
units.en: army commanders and inner palace commissioners, deputy commissioners, attendants, and palace guards are to memorialize for the time being to hear the edict's decision."
units.literal: army commanders and inner palace commissioners, deputy commissioners, attendants, and palace guards memorialize for the time being to hear the edict's decision."

units.zh: 由是內外品官當贖之法，始有定制焉。
units.en: Thereby the law of commutation for ranked officials inside and outside first received fixed regulations.
units.literal: Thereby the law of commutation for ranked officials inside and outside first had fixed regulations.
